_readme: Single source of truth for values that are repeated across the site. Change a value here, then run: node tools/apply-config.js — it rewrites every occurrence of the OLD value (from config/site.lock.json) with the new one across html/js/json/md, regenerates assets/js/dl-config.js (window.DL_CONFIG) and rebuilds the core bundle. Never edit the lock file by hand.

support._note: 10 digits, no +91. The tool also rewrites the spaced form '95412 23377' and 'wa.me/91…'. The DB copy (is_admin / verify_mobile in db/*.sql) is NOT touched — change it with a migration.

cities_fallback._note: Used by register.html and panel/login.html when the DB city list has not loaded. Live list is geo_cities.

limits._note: max_photos must match the DB trigger enforce_photo_limit (db/231). Change both.

supabase._note: Public values (anon key is safe to ship; RLS + db/225 column grants are the real lock). api/*.js read env vars first and fall back to these.
